CMS Developer (HubSpot)
Beacon Digital Group

The opportunity

Beacon Digital Group is a Toronto marketing-technology agency. Our development team ships HubSpot CMS sites, landing-page systems, and CRM-integrated tooling for B2B clients. We need a CMS Developer who can take a design system and turn it into clean, maintainable HubL themes and modules.

Responsibilities

- Develop HubSpot CMS themes, templates, and custom modules using HubL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Build reusable drag-and-drop modules marketers can safely compose without developer help
- Integrate HubSpot CRM data into site experiences (smart content, membership, HubDB)
- Connect HubSpot to external systems via REST APIs, webhooks, and serverless functions
- Migrate client sites from WordPress and other platforms into HubSpot CMS
- Implement on-page SEO: structured data, semantic markup, page-speed optimization
- Set up and maintain forms, workflows, and lifecycle tracking with the marketing team
- Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and client demos

Requirements

- 2-4 years of web development experience with at least one CMS platform in production (HubSpot, WordPress, Contentful, or similar)
- Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals
- Experience consuming and debugging REST APIs
- Understanding of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
- Experience with Git-based workflows
- Strong attention to design detail; you can match a Figma file without supervision

Assets

- HubSpot CMS certification or HubSpot developer experience specifically
- Experience with email template development
- Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking
- Exposure to TypeScript or a modern framework (React, Vue)

Details

Hybrid in downtown Toronto, $65,000-$85,000 CAD depending on experience, three weeks vacation, benefits from day one.
